propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit discovery (cwd or git -C) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting.
Git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD initialization fail with exit 128 in reclaim/concurrency fixtures when Git safety policy rejects implicit bare-repository discovery.
Generic cwd/git -C helpers designed for worktrees inadvertently erase bare-repository intent, causing Git 2.55+ protected policy rejection while default config succeeds.
Explicit --git-dir targeting on intentional bare repositories restores fixture success under strict policy without weakening Git safety settings or breaking worktree semantics.
Production script prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore shares the same implicit-discovery defect on its throwaway restore.git and requires aligned explicit targeting.
